# lightdash_personal_access_tokens (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of all personal access tokens for the authenticated user. This data source provides details for each token, including its UUID, description, creation timestamp, expiration date, rotation timestamp, and last used timestamp. The tokens are sorted by their UUID. Note that the actual token values are not returned by this data source for security reasons.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all personal access tokens for the authenticated user
data "lightdash_personal_access_tokens" "all" {}

# Output the list of tokens
output "tokens" {
  value = data.lightdash_personal_access_tokens.all.tokens
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The data source identifier. It is computed as `personal-access-tokens`.
- `tokens` (Attributes List) A list of personal access tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the personal access token was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the personal access token.
- `expires_at` (String) The expiration date of the personal access token.
- `last_used_at` (String) The timestamp when the personal access token was last used.
- `rotated_at` (String) The timestamp when the personal access token was last rotated.
- `token_uuid` (String) The UUID of the personal access token.
